# 1 Chronicles Chapter 24 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 382v–383r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/1CH_024_page_001.jpg, 1CH_024_page_002.jpg

---

**24:1** And-to-the-sons of-Aharon, their-divisions [machleqotam]: the-sons of-Aharon: Nadav, and-Avihu, El'azar, and-Itamar. **24:2** And-died Nadav and-Avihu before [lifney] their-father, and-sons not were to-them, and-served-as-priests [vayekhahanu] El'azar and-Itamar.

**24:3** And-divided-them David — and-Tsadoq from-the-sons of-El'azar, and-Achimelekh from-the-sons of-Itamar — according-to-their-appointment [pequddatam] in-their-service [ba-avodatam]. **24:4** And-were-found the-sons of-El'azar more [rabbim] as-to-heads of-the-mighty-men [roshey ha-gevarim] than the-sons of-Itamar, and-they-divided-them: to-the-sons of-El'azar, heads for-the-house of-fathers [le-veyt avot] — sixteen, and-to-the-sons of-Itamar, for-the-house of-their-fathers — eight.

**24:5** And-they-divided-them by-lots [ba-goralot], these with those, for there-were officers of-the-sanctuary [sarey qodesh] and-officers of-God [sarey ha-elohim] from-the-sons of-El'azar and-from-the-sons of-Itamar. **24:6** And-wrote-them Shemayah son of-Netan'el, the-scribe [ha-sofer], from the-Levi, before [lifney] the-king and-the-officers, and-Tsadoq the-priest, and-Achimelekh son of-Evyatar, and-the-heads of-the-fathers for-the-priests and-for-the-Levi'im — one house-of-father being-taken [achuz] for-El'azar, and-one being-taken for-Itamar.

**24:7** And-came-out the-lot [ha-goral], the-first, to-Yehoyariv; the-second to-Yedayah; **24:8** the-third to-Charim; the-fourth to-Se'orim; **24:9** the-fifth to-Malkiyyah; the-sixth to-Miyyamin; **24:10** the-seventh to-Haqqots; the-eighth to-Aviyyah; **24:11** the-ninth to-Yeshu'a; the-tenth to-Shekhanyahu; **24:12** the-eleventh to-Elyashiv; the-twelfth to-Yaqim; **24:13** the-thirteenth to-Chuppah; the-fourteenth to-Yeshev'av; **24:14** the-fifteenth to-Bilgah; the-sixteenth to-Immer; **24:15** the-seventeenth to-Chezir; the-eighteenth to-Happitsets; **24:16** the-nineteenth to-Petachyah; the-twentieth to-Yechezqel; **24:17** the-twenty-first to-Yakhin; the-twenty-second to-Gamul; **24:18** the-twenty-third to-Delayahu; the-twenty-fourth to-Ma'azyahu.

**24:19** These [are] their-appointments [pequddatam] for-their-service [la-avodatam], to-come to-the-house of-YHWH according-to-their-ordinance [ke-mishpatam], by-the-hand of-Aharon their-father, as commanded-him YHWH, God of-Yisra'el.

**24:20** And-to-the-rest of-the-sons of-Levi: to-the-sons of-Amram — Shuva'el; to-the-sons of-Shuva'el — Yechdeyahu. **24:21** To-Rechavyahu — to-the-sons of-Rechavyahu: the-head [was] Yishshiyyah. **24:22** To-the-Yitshari — Shelomot; to-the-sons of-Shelomot — Yachat. **24:23** And-the-sons [of-Chevron]: Yeriyyahu, Amaryahu the-second, Yachazi'el the-third, Yeqam'am the-fourth. **24:24** The-sons of-Uzzi'el — Mikhah; to-the-sons of-Mikhah — Shamir. **24:25** The-brother of-Mikhah — Yishshiyyah; to-the-sons of-Yishshiyyah — Zekharyahu.

**24:26** The-sons of-Merari: Machli and-Mushi. The-sons of-Ya'aziyyahu — Beno. **24:27** The-sons of-Merari by-Ya'aziyyahu: Beno, and-Shoham, and-Zakkur, and-Ivri. **24:28** To-Machli — El'azar, and-not were to-him sons. **24:29** To-Qish — the-sons of-Qish: Yerachme'el. **24:30** And-the-sons of-Mushi: Machli, and-Eder, and-Yerimot. These [are] the-sons of-the-Levi'im according-to-the-house of-their-fathers.

**24:31** And-cast they also lots [goralot], corresponding to [le-ummat] their-brothers the-sons of-Aharon, before [lifney] David the-king, and-Tsadoq, and-Achimelekh, and-the-heads of-the-fathers for-the-priests and-for-the-Levi'im — the-head of-the-fathers corresponding to [le-ummat] his-younger brother.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1 — machleqotam (their-divisions):** The noun *machaloqet* (division, course) is the Chronicler's signature term for organized temple service. From the root ch-l-q (to divide/apportion), it implies an ordered rotation — the foundation of Second Temple priestly organization.

**v.5 — sarey qodesh / sarey ha-elohim:** "Officers of the sanctuary" and "officers of God" — these titles likely describe the same officials, not two separate groups. Both Eleazar's and Ithamar's lines held such positions, requiring the lot system.

**v.6 — one being-taken for-El'azar, and-one being-taken for-Itamar:** The Hebrew *achuz echad achuz* describes the alternating selection process — one lot drawn for Eleazar's line, then one for Ithamar's, maintaining fairness despite Eleazar's numerical advantage (16 to 8).

**v.10 — Aviyyah (Abijah):** The eighth priestly course — the division to which Zechariah, father of John the Baptist, belonged (Luke 1:5). A direct link between this administrative list and the New Testament.

*— EMET*
